Greetings to you all. I am Boothill, the Galaxy Ranger.
As the evening breeze of Asdana carries with it the tender whispers of approaching summer, I humbly pray that your noble selves remain in radiant health, untouched by the vexations of seasonal ailments, so as not to miss the splendor of this midsummer's enchanting beauty.
Though but a humble fugitive, it is my profound honor to stand alongside your esteemed selves in the pursuit of the Holy Grail.
As such, with a heart brimming with reverence and gratitude, I extend to you a most earnest invitation to grace Clock Studios Theme Park with your presence. There, I shall humbly offer a modest feast of wine and fare in your esteemed company.
In this season of summer's retreat, Clock Studios Theme Park has transformed into a realm of poetic wonder, a paradise on earth that promises to etch unforgettable memories upon your hearts.
Should you deign to accept my invitation, I would be overjoyed beyond measure. I shall eagerly await your reply. May this humble gathering serve as a cherished testament to the bond we share, and may it bestow upon you a moment of delight and respite amidst your noblest endeavors.
With the highest regards and the deepest wishes,
Here's to you,
Salutations from,
Yours humbly,
Boothill

An hour after the SparxiCon ended, netizens of the Planarcadia were shocked to discover that Sparxicle, who had supposedly vanished from all platforms, had reappeared in an unexpected way: a totally unannounced <color=#fa7919>"comeback stream"</color>, causing countless fans to flood back into her streaming room.

<align="right"><color=#9d8563>Reporter: Furbulitzer</color></align>

<color=#b2b1b1><align="center">♥♥ The following is excerpted from Sparxie's "comeback stream" ♥♥</align></color>

Hello hello! My dear Sparxheads, did you miss me?

Miss me? <size=28><color><icon SpriteName=EmojiFifthWorldNews id=0 width=1 height=1></color>Miss me?</size> Or <size=36><color><icon SpriteName=EmojiFifthWorldNews id=1 width=1 height=1></color><color><icon SpriteName=EmojiFifthWorldNews id=2 width=1 height=1></color>super-duper miss me?</size>

Now, answer Sparxie one question as the opening for this stream: "Should rising fireworks be viewed in the night sky, or in its reflection on the lake?"

The answer is... neither! You should watch them from all those screens, big and small, that you can hold in your hands when you look down or see all around you when you look up! Sparxie's smile is the brightest firework in the summer night, it's magic that goes "POP!" in your heart like soda, so make sure to give me all your L-O-V-E, and look forward to seeing me this time, next time, and every time, teehee~

Of course, what this means is: <color=#fa7919>Even though Sparxie has withdrawn from the Phantasmoon Games, I'll still be here to keep my Sparxheads company!</color>

Did that "Everyone is Sparxie" masquerade party just now scare you? I'm truly sorry, for infecting you with the "Sparxie" virus and letting you face the slander from <color=#fa7919>{RUBY_B#boring, dull}our greatest enemy{RUBY_E#}</color> against my Sparxheads. But it's okay to fail sometimes, 'cause some things are beautiful precisely because they're broken, that's true for the internet world, for a maiden's mask, and for people's chaotic words too.

Your beloved Sparxie has only ever wanted to shield her Sparxheads from enemy attacks and share laughter and joy with everyone! Though I did think that because of everyone's love for Sparxie, and your accepting hearts, maybe it would be okay to be selfish and announce my <color=#fa7919>{RUBY_B#"farewell" stream}"farewell"{RUBY_E#}</color>...

But how could I bear to leave my Sparxheads, and how could I stand to see Planarcadia's internet become like watered-down craft beer in a tavern without Sparxie's joy-inducing secretions?

Here's an announcement: <color=#fa7919>"Sparxie's streaming activities are suspended indefinitely!"... Just kidding!</color> As Planarcadia approaches the millennium, <unbreak>99.99%</unbreak> of internet memes will be born from Sparxie's streaming room, so keep supporting Sparxie, and let's meet at the peak!

Pinky promise with me, you'll be responsible for loving Sparxie forever<color><icon SpriteName=EmojiFifthWorldLove id=3 width=1 height=1></color>
